name: Gurglhof
beschreibung:
Perched in high-altitude Obergurgl, Hotel Gurglhof welcomes discerning travellers with luxurious rooms, a 500 sqm spa oasis, and exquisite dining directly on the slopes of the Oetztal Alps.

The Hohe Mut and Rosskar cable cars and the vast Obergurgl-Hochgurgl ski area start right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gurglhof in Obergurgl provides premier ski-in/ski-out convenience and luxury wellness above 1,900 metres.
